alterations.description: Delete shots showing the sahukar shivering, men armed with axes and spears about to attack, and a man in white pacifying the mob. Omit any suggestion of violence in the commentary.
Curtail drastically the scene where Beli and then Kamo are shown being whipped by Munshi. Show only one or two strokes.
Omit part of the scene showing Beli sitting with his back bearing marks of severe whipping.
Curtail somewhat the hand of the wounded Kamo showing blood dripping from it.
Delete the policeman's words threatening to break Ramu's leg if he returns.
Delete the close-up shot of the lady singer swooping and falling backwards upon Ramu.
Delete the sequence of the thief stealing from the safe, the durwan discovering and threatening him, his sharing the spoils, and cheating the latter. Leave only a suggestion of the theft.
Delete Rupa's words 'Damp it'.

Delete Ramu being addressed as 'God (Kadavul)' by Singam inside the jail, except at the beginning where Singam states Ramu is venerated by him as God. Also delete this term in Reel 16 where Ramu takes leave of Singam.
Delete the appearance of persons in Indian Naval uniform in the staged drama, except for their disembarkation from the ship and departure.
Delete the shot of the photograph chosen by Rupa for the doctor and the close-up shots of Rupa's bust after she and Rajee are separated by the doctor, up to where she says 'I love you doctor'.
Voluntary deletion of balance of sequence containing persons in Naval uniform etc.
Delete Vasantasena telling Malini 'I am the Maharaja's bed' (sound only).
Delete the picture of the dancer in close-up during the first verse of song.
Delete the last verse of song 7 with picturisation from the words 'Yes, what do you say must be done now'.
In song 7, delete references to Vasantan as 'Ramaswamidoota' and Hanuman (sound only).
Malini being pulled by hand in the rehearsal of Vasantan's durbar.

Delete Ugrasena telling Malini 'Do you think baktimarga is going to be expounded here now' and Vasantasena telling Ugrasena 'Why do you look at me as if you are going to eat me', with accompanying picturisation in each case.
Voluntary deletion of Manohara being taken in a chariot for execution after durbar scene.
Delete the picture of the Ticket Collector at the Railway gate, where Malathi enters the platform after paying him Rs. 5.
Cut out all the drink scenes and the toast.
Reduce the second kiss on the bench before the wedding.
Delete the sentence 'This is your turn Sir,' addressed to the Professor.
Close-up shot from below at the edge of the bathing pool (skirts swirling up).
Reduce to the minimum shots of Danny being punched whilst standing against the post of the ring.
Insert a tablet in Hindi to the effect that the story of the film relates to the pre-independence era.
Shot of Shekhar actually snatching the necklace from the lady.
The scene showing Shekhar's escape from custody of the police in the car.
Banke's words as spoken to the policemen 'Bade anye police ke dum' and the picking out of the handkerchief from the latter's pocket.
Banke's words 'Aur main bhi koi kiraye ki sarkar utha laoongu' spoken while pointing to the statue of a female.
The flash-back of Chandrashekhar Azad being tortured (as seen by him in memory).
The sabotage of the Railway train.
Torturing of Chandrashekhar Azad in the jail to the minimum.
Chandrashekhar's attack on postman, specially the part where the impression is of the postman having been killed.
Considerably all scenes of third-degree tortures from the picture.
The sequence of Chandrashekhar Azad and Didi with Mr. Scott.
The scene showing Chandrashekhar Azad robbing a postman.
The scene showing in silhouette three corpses hanging by the ropes, after Bhagat Singh and his two companions were hanged.
Before the titles, delete the picture of Rajan's blood-stained hand in close-up.
Delete the same shot where it occurs in Reel No. 15.
Delete the insert pictures of the police inspector reacting, when he is interviewing Usha.
Delete detective's remarks about proper dress and improper actions.
In the park sequence, delete Ambujam's statement that it is her family occupation to remain waiting.
Delete detective's remarks about the new truth he had discovered, about the various named religions, and the similarity in the facts of the case investigated.
Delete the consequential reference in the police station.
Delete the consequential reference to 'Andha Kadavul' (sound only removed; modification approved).

Delete picture of slogans written on the wall, when the camera is focused on them. Delete the entire sequence, sound and picture from the time the song 'Maugu Pennasait' is heard off-screen, including the interrogation of the priest, the insert picture of his wife, the remarks of the detective, when young girls pass on the street, up to and including the priest pointing to Shanmugham and saying that 'the latter was the go-between for that house'.
Reduce the sound of Chinniah's choking and hiccup.
Delete Rajan's remark with accompanying picture 'I shall remain here looking after the vessels'.

Delete the picture and speech of Rajan about the collections for fund, and his asking Pottai to shake the collection box, up to and including his remark that 'that there is no limit to the number of such collections'.
Delete Rajan's remarks about 'fasting for many days without achieving anything'.
Delete the statement that thought had been devoted at Kashi and Kanchi.
Delete the remarks of Rajan to Usha, 'if your God had eyes, he was also going to see'.
Delete the detective and the Inspector lifting their hats off and telling Usha that though they had to arrest her by way of duty for the murder, they could not but pay homage to her.
The scene showing Mohania's expression of bust as Naren advances towards her and their consequent embrace, eliminating the shot showing Naren bolting the door.
Storm shots.
Portion of the scene between Narendra and father when former apologises to latter and seeks permission to retire to village.
All scenes of mob violence and arson on the part of un-Aryans, including burning of cottages of Rishis and slaughter of Rishis.
The savage treatment meted out by Valmiki to his guru, culminating in the latter's murder at the hands of his former devoted disciple.

Delete Nicky's scream from inside the bedroom when Matt opens the door and their dialogues up to Matt's words 'I used to bathe you when you were a kid', reducing kissing and cuddling between them (entire sequence has been deleted).
Reduce Matt kissing Nicky in water to once only.
Song 'Mere hun ka charcha' along with picturisation of dance by a small girl.
Words 'Kismatmen meri Gecta, japo Ram, japo Seeta'.
Clownish movements of Kishore's assistant.
Impression of kidnapping of the street-singer immediately after her song.
Babu's words to Chikuwali 'zara Pyar se bolo to mujhe maza ata hai'.
Court passing sentence of death on Madan.
Word Lahu as referred to in respect of Lachhoo. Kumar's words to Seeta 'Zabardasti main apni pyas bujha ke rahunga'.
View of Lachhu's mutilated hands. Flashes of dacoities committed by Lachoo when in desperation he reverts to his former life of crime.
Alter the name Diler to Dilersingh.
In the dance scene, delete the idol as the background.
The long Kiss that the lady doctor gives to Jerry at the time of parting.
The shots of the murdered body hanging in the cloth cupboard in the hotel.
All dialogues referring to jokes about married couples in the film should be deleted.
Reference 'Tehsildar' in respect of the man as shown non-cooperation with the villagers. (Sound replaced with Zamindar).
To one long shot view of the burning pyre.
Whipping of the Thakur.
Whipping of the Thakur and his daughter.
